name: Otowa Saki
source:
Recently, she won a famous violin competition and has been in the limelight. She
usually has a gentle and relaxed demeanor, but when she plays the violin, she shows a dignified expression.

She started playing the violin at a young age, but she always fell just short of the mark in competitions and was unable to achieve any results.
However, she continued to practice harder than anyone else and finally saw results.
She was invited to this cruise as a job.

Because her family's finances are not easy, she thought about quitting the violin several times, but her parents let her continue, saying, "It's okay."

In order to repay her parents' feelings, she wants to become famous as a violinist, earn money, and make her parents' lives easier.
